quotes.text: `storeObserver` calls `handleStateChange` only when a selector result changes. A draft update can trigger `draftState` without a `canSave` callback when `selectCanSave` stays the same Boolean; it requires a draft, no pending operation, and valid stored active sections, not dirty state. [Task 1]
